Name: Farm Anywhere
Author: hmkiesel
Description:
Updates to allow crops and fruit trees to be planted on all standard locations. Allows farmer to plant in-season crops and fruit trees in the town, on the beach, in the forest & mountains, etc. Also adds more diggable tiles, to allow planting crops on dirt and grassy areas.

Whether you want to plant coconut trees on the beach, decorate the town with flowers, or just need more space to farm crops, this mod will let you do it all!

0 map replacements to improve compatibility with custom map mods.
Compatible with SDV 1.6

Works well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13843]Perennial Flowers[/url] to allow you to decorate Pelican Town with flowers that never die.
